subject: Final quick question on alignment & decision window
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fastcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Final quick question on alignment & decision window

Hi Samir — great talking yesterday, thanks again for the time. I promised a short recap so your team can share feedback quickly. Quick TL;DR and one question at the bottom.

Recap (3 bullets):
- Scope: inference for personalized recommendations (batch scoring + nearline rerank) at ~250qps peak, model size ~13B. You flagged latency targets of ~80–120ms p50.
- Success metrics: 10% lift in CTR for promoted widgets; cost per 1M tokens must stay under your current budget band.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence and VPC-only deployment; procurement cycle targets July.

Where I could use a 30-second signal from you: does the proposed approach map to what you described (match / partial match / not a fit)? If partial, what’s the biggest mismatch (latency, cost, compliance, other)?

If it is a match, the concrete next step we recommended on the call: a two-week pilot (dev->staging) to validate latency and cost on a representative slice. Proposed decision window: target go/no-go by the end of July so you can hit Q3 rollout planning.

Options — please reply with one of the three so we can align ops:
1) Match — yes to pilot, we should schedule a 30-min kickoff in the next 10 business days.
2) Partial — we need clarity on X (say latency or data access); we’ll loop in infra/product and propose a small spike.
3) No — call it out and we’ll close the thread.

If it helps, here’s a 15-minute calendar link for quick alignment: https://cal.redwood.ai/irene/15 (feel free to propose a time).

Thanks — small ask here because I know procurement and schedules are tight.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182


From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final quick question on alignment & decision window

Quick bump — circling back on the note below. Two tiny additional data points that might help:
- Example latency from similar customers at 250qps: p50 ≈ 70–90ms (with batching and prefix cache).
- Typical pilot budget range we’ve seen: $3k–$8k for a two-week validation depending on sample size.

No rush — just trying to avoid missing your procurement window in July. If you want me to loop in Marissa (our solutions lead) for a quick technical Q&A, say the word and I’ll add her.

Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final quick question on alignment & decision window

One last quick ask — promise this is short. If you don’t have time for a call, would you mind answering one of these in a single line?
A) Rate fit 1–5 (5 = excellent match)
B) Say “no” and I’ll stop following up
C) Say “partial” + one sentence on the main blocker

If you pick A, I’ll send over a proposed kickoff window and a one-page pilot plan for your procurement team. If B, I’ll archive the thread. If C, I’ll loop in Marissa and the product engineer to scope a mitigation spike.

Appreciate the quick signal — procurement timelines are real and I don’t want to create noise.

Thanks again,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
